enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Bend knees. Move arm. Turn head. Remain asleep. Breathe deeply. Shift position. Pull blanket down. Turn to back. Keep eyes closed. Remain still. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Open eyes. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pick up bag. Check contents. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to locker room. Change into uniform. Walk to work station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check schedule. Review patient files. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Talk to patient. Record notes. Walk to nurse station. Update records. Attend team meeting. Discuss cases. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to another patient room. Assist with mobility. Provide wound care. Document care given.
Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay cashier. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Dispose trash. Return tray. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Attend meeting. Discuss cases. Examine patient. Administer treatment. Monitor vital signs. Adjust equipment. Talk to family members. Update records. Walk to lab. Collect test results. Return to station. Consult with doctor. Prepare discharge papers. Assist patient with dressing. Educate patient on medication. Document discharge. Clean equipment. Walk to break room. Drink water. Return to station.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Remove shoes. Walk to living room.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Fill pot with water. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Boil water. Add pasta. Stir with spoon. Cut vegetables. Heat pan. Add oil. Cook chicken. Drain pasta. Combine ingredients. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Wipe counter.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch program. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Return to living room. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch more TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust pillow. Lie down on couch. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Pour water. Return to living room. Sit down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Remain still. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping.
